note: Stable error codes of the machine contract. Adding a code is a minor change; removing or renaming one is a major change (docs/CONTRACT.md). `exit` is the process exit status in --json mode: 1 = the work was refused or failed, 2 = the call itself was wrong. Generated from lib/contract.cjs.

NOT_A_PROJECT.description: The path does not exist or holds no RoyaScaff project.

UNKNOWN_ID.description: A record, task, change, slice, feature or backup the call names does not exist.

GATE_REFUSED.description: A gate refused the step; `missing` lists what must be done first.

HUMAN_REQUIRED.description: Only a person can do this step (an approval, a look, a confirmation); an AI or a script cannot.

STALE_APPROVAL.description: The approval no longer holds because what was approved has changed since.

OUTSIDE_PATHS.description: Files changed outside the paths the task allows.

CHECK_FAILED.description: A check the step depends on ran and failed.

VERSION_MISMATCH.description: The project, the engine or the requested version do not fit each other.

ALREADY_EXISTS.description: What the call would create, or the state it would set, is already there.

INVALID_INPUT.description: The call is malformed: a missing argument, a bad option value or wrong usage.

UNKNOWN_COMMAND.description: The command does not exist in this engine version.

INTERNAL.description: An error the engine has no stable code for yet; the message says what happened.
